name: Cougar Claws
summary: Across Mulgore’s central plains, tauren hunters gather Cougar Claws for a cleansing ritual. The claws come from flatland cougars, among the grasslands’ apex hunters.

sections.title: A Vessel of Natural Balance
sections.body:
Flatland cougars hunt by instinct among Mulgore’s grasslands. For the tauren, gathering their claws is neither slaughter for its own sake nor trophy hunting. It gathers the beasts’ natural spirit.

When goblin operations defile the plains’ ancestral waters, Mull Thunderhorn asks young hunters to gather Cougar Claws and prairie stalker claws. The tauren weave native beasts’ pure predatory instincts into a ritual totem. They mean it to scour toxins and foul sorcery from the poisoned Thunderhorn Water Well.

faq.q: What are Cougar Claws used for?
faq.answer: Mull Thunderhorn uses Cougar Claws with stalker claws to craft the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem. The tauren weave the spirit of native predators into ritual objects to purify wells poisoned by goblin industry.

faq.q: Where do Cougar Claws come from?
faq.answer: Flatland cougars prowl Mulgore’s rolling plains, especially east and west of Bloodhoof Village. Their claws provide Cougar Claws.

faq.q: Why does Mull Thunderhorn need predator claws to cleanse a well?
faq.answer: Tauren shamanic and druidic traditions honor the purity of wild beasts’ hunting. Native predators live in balance with the land, unlike goblins who exploit and defile it. Their essence can counter artificial corruption.

faq.q: Are Cougar Claws useful for anything else?
faq.answer: Beyond crafting the ritual totem for the Thunderhorn Water Well, Cougar Claws have no specialized use. They are typically sold to local traders.

angles.text: Gathering Cougar Claws teaches young tauren that hunting serves balance and spiritual need. That lesson stands against pollution caused by goblin enterprises.
As a shaman, you know local predators’ essence remains tied to the spirits of the plains. It can carry their power into purifying wards and cleansing totems.
